rows.note: Use 莓 as the all-purpose everyday term for an ordinary edible berry when no botanical distinction is intended.

example.jyutping: si3 haa5 ni1 nap1 mui4 hou2 tim4 gaa3

rows.note: Use 漿果 for the technical botanical category of berry, especially in scientific or educational contexts.

example.english: In botany, a tomato is also classified as a berry.
example.traditional: 喺植物學上，番茄都屬於漿果。
example.jyutping: hai2 zik6 mat6 hok6 soeng6 faan1 ke2 dou1 suk6 jyu1 zoeng1 gwo2
